Instead, hourly volume collapsed 93% down to 6,674 ZEC over four hours while price held above $1,290. That sudden drop in volume isn't necessarily buyer exhaustion—it shows sell pressure dried up once initial profit-taking ended. Price isn't getting rejected; it's coiling in equilibrium. The invalidation is clear: losing swing support at $1,234.73 on rising sell volume unwinds the structure. 📊 ZEC 1H: price $1310.26 • support $1101.93 • resistance $1385.65 • TP1 $1456.58 • target $1527.51 • SL / invalidation $1101.93 (long bias).
